items.claim: Define a selected finite-regulator model's 0-form/1-form symmetry action, physical coupling to the finite 2-group background groupoid, field/observable assignments and declared counterterm scheme, without asserting a continuum realization.

items.argument_disposition: Definition supplied with current-ready topological-defect and p-form interfaces, exact finite cochain/groupoid formulas, and explicit model field, action, measure, observable, units and scope. All six direct suppliers were read at their current statements/proofs and have current-ready Step 1 records; their exact support/isotopy, p=1 charge/background, left-action, cocycle and gauge-coherence hypotheses match the use. items.claim: For a finite-regulator model whose gauge arrows act by bijections and whose dimensionless weights acquire a specified field-independent phase, prove the background partition-function and unnormalized-correlator variation by finite reindexing and state the local-counterterm equivalence.
source_uses: Benini, Córdova and Hsin §3 introduction, printed pp. 20–21 / PDF pp. 21–22: background-gauge phase, local counterterms and anomaly; §1.3 for the Postnikov distinction.
Schäfer-Nameki §2.8.2, printed p. 33: gauging a 1-form symmetry may induce a mixed anomaly, which is retained as a caveat.
items.argument_disposition: Complete conditional finite-sum proof from the explicit model transformation law and exact inspected gauge-groupoid interface. All direct suppliers are present, current-ready and their statement/proof interfaces were matched. It does not compute a phase for an unspecified theory, identify beta with an anomaly, or assert a continuum limit.
